scope: Read-only design review of native consumer compatibility with canonical Vision global-scene-texel contribution bands

facts: Group uses obs_scene_add_group and applies affine to its item after adding every child
SolarBand is cropped from atlas and scaled/positioned into child.rect, then inherits group transform
Opacity filter belongs to native group and is applied once after child composition
Current design assumes all child coordinates local to group

observed.fact: Current affine admission rejects shear before graph replacement

conclusion: Current native hierarchy cannot directly consume pre-rasterized global-scene-texel bands without applying owner transforms again. Using inverse-owner transforms is not a general correction and adds a resampling boundary; group affine shear is unsupported.
candidate_contract: Explicitly distinguish global-scene-texel bands from local physical capture geometry
An isolated native group must composite ordered children into canonical global grid: world raster bands at identity pixel mapping, physical captures through composed owner/world affine exactly once
Apply group opacity once after mixed capture/band composition; nested group operation order must remain authoritative
Preserve authored capture crop, source-local effects, visibility and group masks/effects at their correct existing semantic boundary
Validate complete typed revisions and resources before replacing current accepted graph; never silently degrade unsupported masks/blends/shear
Use bounded reusable targets and explicit render-stack memory accounting; no new inactive scene retention or physical device clone
Re-use existing libobs source refs/removal fences, graphics queue atomic admission and coherent private ABI build
open_before_implementation: Select concrete libobs isolation/render primitive after inspecting native matrix and filtered source semantics
Determine world-grid effect/mask kernels that preserve canonical transformed group semantics; a rotated local blur must not silently become axis-aligned world blur
Prove all affine cases with real mixed physical stand-in and global bands, nested opacity, alpha, paint ordering, reset and teardown
Qualify color-space/premultiplication and zero additional subpixel atlas sampling
Measure retained targets and steady-state native render cost separately from Vision GPU timestamps
limits: Proposal only; no product/native code edits or consumer ABI authorization
Current private native foundation tests do not establish this new global-grid consumer parity
Retained composite-group-render worktree086086 inspected read-only; no matching implementation found in inspected plugin file inventory, not an exhaustive semantic absence proof
